rule.match: failed mTLS handshake|MQTT authentication failure|Client certificate verification failed|Client auth failed
rule.description: WMS: MQTT mTLS handshake or client authentication failure
WMS: Repeated MQTT client authentication failures from same IP (Potential brute force/rogue device)
WMS: Ingestion rate limit threshold hit for device

rule.match: Security Policy Violation: Historical incident audit vectors cannot be altered or removed.
rule.description: WMS: Write/delete attempt blocked by historical log immutability trigger
WMS: Critical configuration file or certificate change detected

rule.match: expiring soon|expires in less than 30 days
rule.description: WMS: Certificate expiration pre-expiry warning (under 30 days remaining)
